profile_scope: One cold parent guest CPU profile per subject and variant, separate from wall measurements. Inclusive percentages overlap. Counts are approximate; not walltime.
codec_scope: Same captured baseline products, N3 full decode/re-encode checks on bump (RC0) and RC1. heap delta is the exported bump pointer increase; RC1 reuse makes it a high-water delta, not total allocation volume. RC0 measures allocation volume. Standalone copied-blob probe remains in both probes as a control and is excluded from measured decode region.
preparation: Initial generated vpkg type declaration side effects caused input freshness refusal. Failed sample quarantined. Prepared compiler and CLI declarations with serial builds using separate scratch cache before all 12 baseline runs. Parsed-source caches remain isolated cold/warm per pair. No source edits/builds/tests overlap timing.
build_harness_source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /home/mizchi/ghq/github.com/mizchi/vibe-lang/_build/evidence-purity-context/_build/perf-env.sh
LAB="$PWD/_build/product-consumption-20261013"
bash scripts/ensure_generated.sh --check
python3 - <<'PREP'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
lab=Path('_build/product-consumption-20261013')
(lab/'b/images').mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(lab/'candidate-generation/stage2.wasm',lab/'b/compiler.wasm')
shutil.copy2('runtime/viberun/target/release/viberun',lab/'b/viberun')
shutil.copy2('scripts/taskgroup_lowering_frontend.mjs',lab/'b/frontend.mjs')
PREP
export VIBE_LIB="$PWD/lib" VIBE_PREOPEN_DIR="$PWD" VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR="$LAB/b/build-cache"
export VIBE_FS_COMPILE=1 VIBE_IMPORT_ABI=raw VIBE_RC=1 VIBE_UNSTABLE=1 VIBE_WASM_NAMES=1 VIBE_RUNNER_EXIT_WITH_RESULT=1
for name in compile worker coordinator; do
 case "$name" in
  compile) src=lib/@vibe/lowering_build/compile.vibe; entry=main; target=compile.wasm; export VIBE_WASM_KEEP_EXPORTS=1;;
  worker) src=lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/worker.vibe; entry=main; target=worker.wasm; unset VIBE_WASM_KEEP_EXPORTS;;
  coordinator) src=lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/coordinator/coordinator.vibe; entry=run; target=coordinator.component.wasm; unset VIBE_WASM_KEEP_EXPORTS;;
 esac
 "$LAB/b/viberun" "$LAB/b/compiler.wasm" "$src" "$LAB/b/images/$target" "$entry"
 test -s "$LAB/b/images/$target"
done
python3 - <<'RECEIPT'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
lab=Path('_build/product-consumption-20261013');a=lab/'b'
h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(a/'images/build.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(version=1,compiler_sha256=h(a/'compiler.wasm'),runner_sha256=h(a/'viberun'),artifacts={n:h(a/'images'/n) for n in ['compile.wasm','worker.wasm','coordinator.component.wasm']}),indent=2)+'\n')
RECEIPT
VIBE_TEST_CLI_WASM="$LAB/b/compiler.wasm" VIBE_RUNNER="$LAB/b/viberun" bash scripts/vibe_test.sh lib/@vibe/compiler/tests/ast_binary_test.vibe lib/@vibe/compiler/tests/ast_binary_type_expr_test.vibe lib/@vibe/compiler/tests/ast_binary_pat_test.vibe lib/@vibe/compiler/tests/ast_binary_expr_test.vibe lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/transport_test.vibe lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/prelude_transport_test.vibe lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/shared_transport_test.vibe lib/@vibe/lowering_worker/module_job_test.vibe > "$LAB/targeted-final.log" 2>&1
python3 scripts/test_taskgroup_lowering.py "$LAB/b/compiler.wasm" "$LAB/b/images" > "$LAB/integration-final.log" 2>&1
